Users should introduce one Retinol product at a time to their skincare routine. Once a tolerance to one Retinol product is built, you can add additional Retinol products to your routine if you wish. NOTE: If your skin shows a reaction, such as redness or a dry patch, take a break from Retinol usage for a few days until the reaction subsides.
